surface.purpose: one presentation-only toggle for the RealPass-owned E3-inspired first-person HUD/nameplate layer
surface.notes: A RealPass version keeps one authored physical simulation. The sole editable public setting controls only the E3-inspired HUD/nameplate presentation and never changes simulation authority.

developmentFeedbackFallback.rule: Do not remove a useful native indicator before the corresponding RealPass Biology/HUD/gameplay feedback has passed attended acceptance. This is a development transition rule, not the final presentation target.

publicControls.description: Toggles the RealPass-owned red E3-inspired first-person HUD and NPC-nameplate visual layer. The physical simulation and modern scanner remain unchanged.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
Development authority gates are never persisted as normal player preferences.
The E3-inspired HUD preference may suppress only the RealPass visual skin/nameplate presentation; underlying physical state and consequences continue unchanged.
binaryPreferenceRule: The sole public boolean changes only the RealPass-owned E3-inspired HUD/nameplate presentation and cannot change physical state, rates, damage, protection, injury, pain state, treatment, recovery or other simulation authority.
